where: lower tree on the right cliff
desc: The lower tree's leaf clusters float in mid-air with visible gaps between them and the trunk.

verify.why: Layered, stylized leaf clusters with slight spacing are standard for this painterly/low-poly foliage art style.

where: tree on the right cliff face
desc: The tree trunk and foliage clip directly out of the smooth cliff rock face without roots or an anchor.

verify.why: The tree is visibly anchored to the cliff wall by a wooden scaffolding frame structure behind it.

where: fence posts along the lower path edge
desc: The bottom of the wooden fence posts float slightly above the sloping rock terrain instead of meeting the ground.

verify.why: The fence posts are mounted onto a continuous wooden beam running along the edge of the path rather than floating above the ground.

where: lower bush on the right cliff face
desc: The bush cluster floats against the sheer rock face without any visible trunk, root, or soil supporting it.

verify.why: Placing foliage clusters directly onto cliff walls to decorate sheer surfaces is standard practice for stylized environments.

where: water surface in the middle ground
desc: A wooden plank floats on the water surface without visible physics or support structures.

verify.why: Wooden planks naturally float on water, so requiring supporting structures beneath floating debris in a dock environment is unnecessary.

where: floating rectangular plane on the water near the pier
desc: A thin rectangular plane floats unexplained over the water near the dock structure.

verify.why: The object is an intended wooden plank floating on the harbor water as environmental clutter rather than an untextured technical geometry error.

desc: A green wooden board floats flat on the water surface without any supporting structure or physics interaction.

verify.why: Wood naturally possesses buoyancy, so floating flat on the water surface without underlying pillars is expected physics behavior.

where: upper walkway network along the cliff face
desc: Overlapping wooden platforms, ladders, and structural supports blend together against the dark rock wall, making walkable routes ambiguous.

verify.why: The upper cliff walkways are clearly delineated by distinct platforms, guardrails, and lighting that form readable tiered routes.

where: rock wall texture on the far left background
desc: The large cavern/cliff wall on the left terminates abruptly into dark shadow, making the environment boundary feel incomplete.

verify.why: The dark areas on the cavern wall represent normal atmospheric shadowing rather than unfinished environment geometry.

desc: The massive dark cliff wall on the left terminates abruptly into a flat empty backdrop, revealing the edge of the world geometry.

verify.why: The rock face extends across the background into atmospheric fog rather than terminating to reveal missing world geometry.
